Hymn 241: Count Your Blessings
Time Signature: 6/8
Musical Key: E-flat Major
Composer: Edwin O. Excell
Lyricist/Text Author: Johnson Oatman Jr.
Category: Special Topics

This is hymn number 241 titled "Count Your Blessings" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in E-flat Major with a 6/8 time signature. 
The music was composed by Edwin O. Excell and the lyrics were written by Johnson Oatman Jr..
This hymn is categorized under: Special Topics.
